subject: NorthBridge compliance walkthrough — slot selection and pen-test vendor note

Possible windows for our security and ops teams:
- Tue 15 Jun — 09:30–11:00 ET
- Wed 16 Jun — 14:00–15:30 ET

We prefer a 60–90 minute slot. Can you propose Redwood attendees and internal roles? We can share the draft DPA and vendor contact.
